newsitem.title: GERMANY: German April unemployment down slightly, sources say.
newsitem.headline: German April unemployment down slightly, sources say.

text.p: German unemployment in April fell to 4.347 million, or 11.3 percent of the work force, from 4.477 million, or 11.7 percent, in March, according to sources who have access to official data to be released on Tuesday.
The sources said the number of people out of work in west Germany slipped to 3.031 million, or 9.8 percent of the work force, and east German jobless totals fell to 1.315 million, or 17.5 percent.
In March, the west German jobless total was 3.127 million, for an unemployment rate of 9.8 percent, and in east Germany 1.350 million people were out of work, a rate of 18.1 percent.
The figures are not adjusted for seasonal influences.
The Federal Labour Office is to release the official data at a news conference in Nuremberg on Tuesday.
